# Results

*Generated by `python -m gbc.cli report`. Do not edit by hand.*

All numbers are out-of-fold predictions from stratified 5-fold cross-validation **grouped on the source image** (1,255 GBCU images). Confidence intervals are 2,000-resample percentile bootstraps over cases. See `docs/data_leakage_audit.md` §5 for the residual patient-level caveat.

## Significance

Exact McNemar, best ensemble (`stack`) vs. best single model (`deit3_small_patch16_224`): 28 cases the ensemble alone gets right, 27 the single model alone gets right, p = 1.

## Calibration

Best ensemble ECE 0.0293 before temperature scaling, 0.0298 after (fitted T = 0.988).

## Shortcut floor

How much of the task is solvable *without* reading tissue. The parent ROI is a radiologist-drawn box, so crop geometry partly encodes lesion size; these baselines use the same grouped folds and no learned representation. A real model has to clear this floor to be interesting.

| baseline                    |   n_features |   accuracy |   balanced_accuracy |
|:----------------------------|-------------:|-----------:|--------------------:|
| majority class              |            0 |     0.4446 |              0.3333 |
| geometry only               |            5 |     0.4550 |              0.4482 |
| geometry + global intensity |           13 |     0.5809 |              0.5771 |

## What the leak is worth

Same backbone, same 2,294 crops, same hyperparameters; the only difference is whether folds are grouped on `image_id`.

| split_scheme                         |   accuracy |   accuracy_ci_low |   accuracy_ci_high |   balanced_accuracy |   malignant_sensitivity |
|:-------------------------------------|-----------:|------------------:|-------------------:|--------------------:|------------------------:|
| grouped (leakage-free)               |     0.7293 |            0.7105 |             0.7467 |              0.7708 |                  0.7532 |
| ungrouped (reproduces shipped split) |     0.7498 |            0.7328 |             0.7672 |              0.7878 |                  0.7611 |

**Accuracy inflation attributable to source-image leakage: +2.0 percentage points.**

## Comparison with the published literature

| method | protocol | accuracy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Expert radiologists (Basu et al. 2022) | patient-wise test set | 68.3-70.0 % |
| ResNet50 (Basu et al. 2022) | 10-fold patient-wise CV | 81.1 +/- 3.1 % |
| InceptionV3 (Basu et al. 2022) | 10-fold patient-wise CV | 84.4 +/- 3.9 % |
| GBCNet + visual-acuity curriculum | 10-fold patient-wise CV | 92.1 +/- 2.9 % |
| **this work, best ensemble** | 5-fold CV grouped on source image | **88.4 %** |

Our grouping is weaker than patient-wise, so this row is **not** a like-for-like comparison with GBCNet and must not be presented as one.
